title: An Interpretive Phenomenological Approach to Library Place-Shaping and Perception of Libraries: Focusing on Student Users of Academic Libraries
author: Kim, Danho and Kim, G.
journal: Journal of the Korean Society for Library and Information Science (한국문헌정보학회지)
abstract: This study explores how academic libraries are perceived and socially constructed as places by student users using an interpretive phenomenological framework and mixed analytical methods.
